notes.title: New version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed a rare stalemate situation where the enemy had only ranged left, so they could not capture the camp, you could not either from same reason, but nobody could end the battle.
 Fixed a bug where the inventory was not reset between runs.
 In addition to destroying the shield token, spears also do 10 damage and have a 100% critical hit chance.
 ESC show/hide the in-game menu (can be configured in the settings)

notes.title: Demo version updated (0.9.7)
notes.notes: A new version of the demo has just been released. Now you can select more than one unit and command them together. We’ve added visual effects, tooltips for the map of Europe, and much more.
